name: todo-webapp
description: The single-page todo app: a signed-in user's private list, with screens to add, edit, complete and delete todos. It renders the UI and calls todo-api for all persistence; it holds no data of its own and performs no server-side logic.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Todo API to list, add, edit, complete and delete the signed-in user's todos.

dependencies.name: thunder
dependencies.description: Signs the user in through Thunder before showing their todo list.
